S1176.L3t: For positive even integers a and b less than 15, the expression a + b + ab can be rewritten as (a+1)(b+1) - 1, so the number of distinct values equals the number of distinct products (a+1)(b+1) with a,b even and less than 15.
S1176.L3f: If you simply count all ordered pairs of positive even integers less than 15 without accounting for duplicates in the resulting sums, you might overcount the number of possible values.
